question: ABCD is a quadrilateral in which AB || DC, and E and F are the midpoints of the diagonals AC and BD, respectively. If AB = 14 cm, BC = 73 cm, DC = 90 cm, and AD = 22 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of EF?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **trapezium**, the length of the segment joining the **midpoints of the diagonals** is half the difference of the parallel sides.

Length of **EF** = (**DC** − **AB**) ÷ 2

⇒ **EF** = (90 − 14) ÷ 2

⇒ **EF** = 76 ÷ 2 = 38 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 38 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **AB** = 14 cm, **DC** = 90 cm, **AB** || **DC**, **E** and **F** are midpoints of **AC** and **BD**.

**Formula Used:** Length of segment joining midpoints of diagonals = |a − b| ÷ 2, where a and b are parallel sides.
